fig7_accuracy_fair.caption:

Compressed methods: at most 1,024 cached rows; Tiered 992 hot + up to 32 cold. Extra cold storage; Full is unrestricted.

fig14_heatmap.caption:

Adapted baselines; extra Tiered cold capacity/attention. Full cache is unrestricted.

fig2_latency_comparison.caption:
All 1,474 records; task totals with different generated lengths. Analytical traffic time, not measured latency or throughput.
Tiered 992 hot / 2,048 cold / 32 quota; assumed STT 50/12.5 GB/s read/write, VRAM 864 GB/s; prefill/compute/interface omitted.

fig6_migration_profile.caption:
All 1,474 records; decode counters sum 32 layers; generated lengths differ. These stacks are event counts, not bytes.
Demotions include backup reuse; deferred candidates perform no transfer. Hysteresis and live-cold-floor gates can defer.

fig11_footprint.caption:
All 1,474 records; observed maxima over post-prefill and final commits only, not runtime peaks. Ordinary GPU mode; 1 MB = 10⁶ bytes.
Backing storage includes visible copies; metadata/weights/activations/allocator reserve omitted. Hypothetical equal-total arm was not evaluated.

fig12_energy.caption:
All 1,474 records; summed free-generation work differs. Assumed STT 2/8 pJ per bit (read/write), VRAM 12 pJ per bit.
Payload-traffic model only: prefill, compute, interface, metadata and system power omitted. No device energy measurement.

primary.endpoint: equal-task macro mean paired score difference, percentage points
primary.method: resample target-document groups with replacement independently within each task; retain all examples within each selected group; equal weight task means
primary.interpretation: Preregistered quality contrast under disclosed unequal cache geometry; not a SOTA or equal-physical-memory test

supplement_faithful_accuracy.caption:
Full 1,474-record descriptive means; error bars=sample SE. Faithful Snap expands KV heads and grows during decode; unequal resources.
Preregistered five-task previously unconsumed stratum: Tiered hot 992 − faithful Snap = -1.37 points; 95% cluster CI [-3.73,0.33]. No superiority.
